smartHome.title: Smart Home
smartHome.subtitle: Sensors, lights, automations, and cameras
smartHome.noReadings: Add sensor readings to get recommendations.

recommendations.warmAir: Open windows for fresh air - temperature is warm and humidity is moderate.
recommendations.poorAir: Air quality is poor - open windows or run ventilation.
recommendations.highHumidity: High humidity - open windows briefly to ventilate.
recommendations.good: Conditions look good - windows can stay closed.

smartHome.automationsSubtitle: IKEA light schedules, sensor rules, and button rules — not chore Routines. The Homebase worker must be running (schedules + Dirigera listener).
smartHome.buttonReadOnlyHint: Button automations are created by script; disable or delete here.
smartHome.noEdgeSensors: No door/window or motion sensors found on the Dirigera hub.
smartHome.sensorRuleHint: Fires on open/close (or motion detect/clear). Turn on/off only changes lights that need it. 2s debounce, 10s cooldown on writes.
smartHome.toggleLeaveHint: Toggle (leave session): Open→light on (occupied). Close while inside ignored. Open again (leaving, light stays on), then Close→light off. Quick visits that never close mid-stay need a later Open+Close or manual off.
smartHome.sunsetLinkHint: Daily adjuster rewrites the stored time from local sunset minus the offset. The worker still fires on that clock. Manual time edits are overwritten on the next adjust.
smartHome.activeHoursHint: Leave both empty for all day. Outside this window the rule will not start (leave-session still finishes so lights turn off).
smartHome.activeWindowIncomplete: Set both Active from and Active until, or leave both empty for all day.
smartHome.saveFailedGeneric: Could not save this automation. Check the fields and try again.
smartHome.noAutomations: No automations yet. Add a schedule or a sensor rule (e.g. door opens → light on).
smartHome.dirigeraSetup: Set {ip} and {token} in {env} on the NAS, then redeploy. Pair with {cmd}. See {doc}.
smartHome.noIkeaLights: No IKEA lights found on the Dirigera hub.
smartHome.livePreviewHint: Updates every few seconds while this tab is open and visible.
smartHome.reolinkHint: Reolink E1 Pro: enable RTSP in the Reolink app. Prefer a DHCP reservation so the IP stays stable. Snapshot uses FFmpeg on the server — credentials stay server-side.
smartHome.configureStream: No preview configured for this camera.
smartHome.legacyStreamHidden: A stream URL with credentials is stored server-side and is not shown in the browser. Re-add as a Reolink camera for a safe snapshot preview.
smartHome.snapshotFailed: Snapshot failed. Check RTSP, password, and that the NAS can reach the camera on the LAN. FFmpeg must be installed in the app container.

delivery.title: Delivery Tracking
delivery.subtitle: Track packages and get arrival alerts

formErrors.reportFailed: Could not send the report. Try again later.

generic.title: Couldn't complete that
generic.why: The action could not be completed with the current input or state.
generic.fix: Check the fields and try again. If it keeps happening, report it to an admin.

active_window_incomplete.title: Couldn't save automation
active_window_incomplete.why: Only one of Active from or Active until was filled in.
active_window_incomplete.fix: Set both times, or leave both empty for all day.

automation_name_required.title: Couldn't save automation
automation_name_required.fix: Enter a name, then save again.

automation_invalid.title: Couldn't save automation
automation_invalid.why: One or more automation fields are invalid.
automation_invalid.fix: Check trigger, lights, and action settings, then try again.

automation_not_found.title: Couldn't update automation
automation_not_found.why: That automation no longer exists (it may have been deleted).
automation_not_found.fix: Refresh the page and pick an existing automation.

product_name_exists.title: Couldn't add product
product_name_exists.why: A product with that name already exists in this household.
product_name_exists.fix: Choose a different name, or open and edit the existing product.

product_not_found.title: Product not found
product_not_found.fix: Refresh the page and try again.

product_has_stock.title: Couldn't delete product
product_has_stock.why: This product still has stock on hand.
product_has_stock.fix: Remove or move the stock first, then delete the product.

product_on_shopping_list.title: Couldn't delete product
product_on_shopping_list.why: This product is still marked as needed on a shopping list.
product_on_shopping_list.fix: Clear it from the shopping list, then try deleting again.

location_has_stock.title: Couldn't delete location
location_has_stock.why: This location still has stock items.
location_has_stock.fix: Move or remove the stock first, then delete the location.

stock_not_found.title: Couldn't remove stock
stock_not_found.why: That stock row is gone (already removed or refreshed).
stock_not_found.fix: Refresh the inventory page and try again if needed.

name_required.title: Name required
name_required.fix: Enter a name and submit again.

quantity_not_positive.title: Invalid quantity
quantity_not_positive.why: Quantity must be a positive number.
quantity_not_positive.fix: Enter a quantity greater than zero.

store_has_needed_items.title: Couldn't delete store
store_has_needed_items.why: This store still has items marked as needed.
store_has_needed_items.fix: Clear or reassign those shopping items, then delete the store.

shopping_item_not_found.title: Couldn't update shopping item
shopping_item_not_found.why: That shopping item no longer exists.
shopping_item_not_found.fix: Refresh the shopping list and try again.

title_required.title: Title required
title_required.fix: Enter a title and try again.

comment_required.title: Comment required
comment_required.fix: Write a short comment, then submit.

invalid_status.title: Invalid status
invalid_status.why: The status value is not allowed.
invalid_status.fix: Pick a status from the list and try again.

chore_not_found.title: Couldn't update chore
chore_not_found.fix: Refresh the tasks page and try again.

invalid_payload.title: Couldn't save recipe
invalid_payload.why: Some recipe fields are missing or invalid.
invalid_payload.fix: Check title, ingredients, and steps, then save again.

recipe_too_large.title: Recipe too large
recipe_too_large.why: The recipe text exceeds the size limit.
recipe_too_large.fix: Shorten ingredients or steps, then save again.

title_conflict.title: Title already used
title_conflict.why: Another recipe already has this title.
title_conflict.fix: Choose a different title and save again.

empty_ingredients.title: Ingredients required
empty_ingredients.fix: Add at least one ingredient, then save.

invalid_timers.title: Invalid timers
invalid_timers.why: One or more timer lines could not be parsed.
invalid_timers.fix: Use a clear label and minutes (for example: Pasta 10), then save.

leftover_not_found.title: Couldn't delete leftover
leftover_not_found.fix: Refresh the page and try again.

delivery_not_found.title: Couldn't update delivery
delivery_not_found.fix: Refresh the delivery page and try again.

invalid_delivery_status.title: Invalid delivery status
invalid_delivery_status.why: The status value is not allowed.
invalid_delivery_status.fix: Pick a status from the list and try again.

file_required.title: File required
file_required.fix: Choose a file, then upload again.

project_not_found.title: Couldn't update project
project_not_found.fix: Go back to the projects list and open an existing project.

invalid_pin.title: Couldn't save vision pin
invalid_pin.why: The pin kind or content is invalid.
invalid_pin.fix: Check the pin type and body or image, then try again.

invalid_pin_link.title: Couldn't link pins
invalid_pin_link.why: Pins cannot link to themselves or across different projects.
invalid_pin_link.fix: Link two pins in the same project.

visitor_preference_not_found.title: Couldn't delete preference
visitor_preference_not_found.why: That visitor preference no longer exists.

invalid_notification_type.title: Couldn't update notification
invalid_notification_type.why: That notification type is not recognized.
invalid_notification_type.fix: Refresh settings and toggle a listed type.

invalid_visitor_preference.title: Couldn't save preference
invalid_visitor_preference.why: The visitor preference data is invalid.
invalid_visitor_preference.fix: Check the fields and try again.

account_update_failed.title: Couldn't update account
account_update_failed.fix: Check the fields (and current password if asked) and try again.

birthday_invalid.title: Invalid birthday
birthday_invalid.why: The birthday value could not be read.
birthday_invalid.fix: Use a valid date, or leave birthday empty.

email_invalid.title: Invalid email
email_invalid.why: That email address is not valid.
email_invalid.fix: Enter a full email address (for example name@example.com).

email_taken.title: Email already registered
email_taken.why: Another account already uses that email.
email_taken.fix: Choose a different email, or sign in with the existing account.

report_rate_limited.title: Too many reports
report_rate_limited.why: You already sent several error reports recently.
report_rate_limited.fix: Wait a few minutes before reporting again.
